CAPABILITY GAP IDENTIFIED:
Activity: "order compliance fulfillment process - Approve fulfillment and schedule resource time"
Requires: (1) order fulfillment authorization, (2) employee time/capacity scheduling for delivery execution
Issue: No single agent or resource combines fulfillment approval + employee time allocation scheduling
- OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine handles fulfillment readiness but not resource scheduling
- SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator handles workforce capability matching but not fulfillment approval
- ProductionChangeOrchestrator handles machine scheduling but not order fulfillment approval or employee time allocation
